decisions.reason: Its own webpage signals visible public commitment and it builds on the established offer, so escalation makes dropping unlikely despite modest results.
A product line with several models represents sunk investment, but the lack of a dedicated page weakens public commitment, yielding a moderate drop probability.
A dedicated page plus a multi-model product line indicates strong investment and public commitment, so escalation strongly favors keeping it.
Only a website mention and a single underlay item suggest little sunk cost and weak public commitment, and after two years its results can no longer be explained by temporary causes.
As a single underlay with only a website mention, it has little invested and no visible commitment, and its continued weak presence makes dropping more likely under escalation logic.
An oak parquet product line close to the core flooring offer implies substantial investment and centrality, so despite no dedicated page, escalation favors keeping it.
